description: This file defines a client class for interacting with an external recipe database service. It contains method stubs for common CRUD operations such as listing recipes, retrieving a specific recipe, and creating a new recipe, all raised as NotImplementedError. It manages auth headers and is intended to be integrated with a real external API in the future.
